subject.title: System prompt: add guidance for spawning background sub-agents

question: Should this maintainer-labeled prompt-policy PR be rebased and consolidated into current sub-agent guidance, changed into a coherent no-nested-spawn policy, or closed manually as already covered?
rationale: Current main and the latest release already cover the useful delegation guidance, but the PR makes a conflicting model-facing policy choice that automation should not resolve for maintainers.

options.title: Rebase And Consolidate Guidance
options.body: Keep only useful examples and merge them into the existing Tooling, Messaging, prefer-delegation, subagent-system prompt, or tool-description surfaces.

options.title: Change Nested Policy Coherently
options.body: If nested spawning should be forbidden, update runtime config, docs, tests, and prompt surfaces together.

options.title: Close As Covered
options.body: If current shipped guidance is sufficient, close this protected stale branch manually instead of carrying duplicate prompt text.

recommendation.title: Rebase And Consolidate Guidance
recommendation.body: Keep only useful examples and merge them into the existing Tooling, Messaging, prefer-delegation, subagent-system prompt, or tool-description surfaces.

likelyOwner.reason: They opened the PR and already made the item-specific product-direction call in the related discussion.
